title: Cranberry.Fit: Diving into Storytelling
summary: Divya and Kahran do a live website teardown of Cranberry.Fit — a femtech brand for PMS and menstrual health — looking at homepage messaging, hero photography, product cards, and the disconnect between Cranberry's playful physical packaging and its more clinical web presence. The conversation doubles as a primer on B2C brand storytelling, community framing, and designing for new acquisition vs returning customers.

intents.display: to watch a brand website get torn down for storytelling
